vol_flash: @a blinding white flash of real lightning seen through bare black branches, a hunched pale creature in front of it throwing its arms over its eyes, its shadow thrown long toward the viewer.
vol_fire_carving: @close-up of an old hand with dark red rune marks carving a flame-shaped rune into a dry log with a flint knife, the cut edges already charring and smoking.
vol_fog_carving: @close-up of an old hand with dark red rune marks carving a wavy rune into a wet black riverside stone, real fog rising from the water and curling around the knife.
vol_green_carving: @close-up of an old hand with dark red rune marks carving a branching rune into the bark of a dead tree, one fresh green bud breaking out beside the cut.
vol_deep_cut: drives a flint knife deep into the trunk of a great oak with both hands, leaning his whole weight on it, pale sap running down the bark.
vol_drone: sits cross-legged with eyes closed and mouth open in a long low drone, a row of small bones and charms on the ground before him trembling.
vol_oaken_staff: @still life: a tall staff of lightning-split oak leaning against a mossy boulder, blackened along the split, hung with small bone charms and a strip of red cloth, mist behind.
vol_hail: raises his staff under a black cloud as real hailstones the size of hazelnuts hammer down on a cowering group of pale creatures.
vol_rime: @close-up of spruce needles, a cobweb and the rim of an iron helmet all coated in thick white hoarfrost at dawn, breath-mist drifting across.
vol_ember: @close-up of a single glowing ember held on a flat stone in an old rune-marked palm, the old man's lips blowing gently on it, a few real flames starting.
vol_warding_circle: walks a circle around his kneeling companions scratching a ring of runes into the earth with the foot of his staff, pale shapes waiting just outside the line.
vol_listen: stands on a bare hilltop with his head tilted and one hand cupped behind his ear, his beard and the charms in it blown sideways by the wind, eyes closed.
vol_bolt: @a single thick bolt of real lightning striking straight down onto a tall thin creature in a forest clearing, the creature's outline black against the white light, rain frozen in the air.
vol_offering_smoke: kneels before a flat stone altar burning a bundle of herbs and a lock of hair, a straight column of grey smoke rising into still air between old oaks.
vol_gust: sweeps his arm and a hard gust of wind full of dead leaves and twigs knocks two pale creatures off their feet.
vol_bind: speaks one word with his palm thrust out, and a lunging grey ghoul stops mid-step with roots and bindweed wrapped tight around its legs and arms.
vol_cinders: @a slumped creature of rotten wood crumbling into grey cinders and glowing flakes in the wind, the old man's staff tip still resting on what is left of it.
vol_stone_idol: @still life: a squat ancient grey stone idol with a worn bearded face standing in tall grass, a wreath of fresh rowan berries around its neck, offerings of bread at its foot.
vol_thunderclap: claps his hands together above his head, and the shock visibly flattens the grass in a ring and staggers the creatures around him, storm clouds overhead.
vol_gift_of_frost: lays his hand on the shoulder of an armoured warrior, whose mail and shield frost over with a white rime as a clawed hand slips off the ice.
vol_warm_rain: stands with his face lifted and arms open in a soft summer rain beside two weary wounded companions, steam rising from the warm earth, a pale break in the clouds.
vol_sacred_fire: @a tall clean bonfire burning inside a ring of old standing stones at night, sparks rising straight up, pale creatures at the edge of the light shielding their faces and backing away.
vol_staff_sweep: sweeps his oak staff low in both hands and takes the legs out from under a charging bony creature.
vol_old_words: @close-up of the bearded mouth of an old man below a birch-bark mask, lips shaping a word, his breath in the cold air forming for a moment the shape of a branching rune.
vol_omen_bird: holds out his arm and a large grey owl lands on his wrist with a strip of birch bark in its beak, a dead tree and a red moon behind.
vol_ash_mark: presses a thumb dipped in ash to the forehead of a snarling grey creature held down under his knee, leaving a black rune.
vol_twin_carving: @close-up of two old rune-marked hands each holding a flint knife, carving two mirrored runes at once into the two halves of a split log.
vol_chain_lightning: @a fork of real lightning jumping in a zigzag from one pale creature to the next across a line of four of them in a rain-soaked field, each caught mid-jerk.
vol_wall_of_ice: stands with his staff planted behind a rough wall of real blue-white ice that has risen from a frozen stream, clawed hands scraping at its far side.
vol_call_fire: thrusts his staff toward a dead pine, which goes up in real flame from root to crown, lighting a ring of startled creatures.
vol_offering: @still life: a flat mossy stone with an offering laid on it: a round loaf, a bowl of honey, a silver ring and a spray of oak leaves, an old rune-marked hand just withdrawing.
vol_seer: sits with a wide shallow bowl of black water on his knees, staring into it, his masked face reflected with a second face behind his shoulder that is not there.
vol_carved_ward: @close-up of a wooden doorpost of a log hut freshly carved with a column of protective runes, claw marks gouged in the wood that stop exactly at the first rune.
vol_sky_wrath: @a whole black storm front rolling over a forest, three bolts of real lightning striking at once among the trees, a tiny figure of an old man with a raised staff on a rock in the foreground.
vol_fog_bank: @a thick bank of grey fog rolling across a swamp and swallowing a line of pale creatures up to the shoulders, only their groping hands above it, an old man's silhouette walking away through it.
vol_word_and_deed: shouts a word and in the same moment brings his staff down on the skull of a kneeling creature.
vol_scorch: @close-up of a clawed grey arm with a long blackened scorch mark still smoking across it, the creature's hand clutching it, embers in the air.
vol_tree_of_life: @a huge old oak in full green leaf standing alone in a dead grey winter forest, warm light under its crown, wounded travellers resting among its roots.
vol_cleansing_fire: walks slowly along a row of sick villagers lying on straw, passing a burning brand over each of them, dark smoke lifting away from their bodies.
vol_burn_rot: holds a flaming brand to a swollen black fungus growing on the trunk of a living tree, the fungus shrivelling and dripping.
vol_elder_song: @three old men in hides and birch-bark masks standing shoulder to shoulder in a snowy oak grove at night singing with their heads thrown back, breath rising in one cloud.
vol_sky_iron: @still life: a rough dark lump of meteorite iron lying in a small scorched crater in the moss, still faintly steaming, a flint knife and a rune-marked hand reaching for it.
vol_dawn: stands on a ridge with his staff raised as the first red line of sunrise breaks over a black forest, pale creatures in the valley below turning and fleeing from the light.
vol_sign_of_veles: @close-up of a large bear paw print pressed deep into wet earth with a small curved horn-shaped rune scratched beside it, an old hand laying a coin in the print.
vol_rune_for_each: moves along a line of four companions, painting a different dark red rune on the forehead of each with his thumb.
vol_storm_brotherhood: @five companions standing in a ring on a hilltop in a storm with their weapons raised and touching in the centre, a bolt of real lightning striking the point where the weapons meet.
vol_sky_hammer: @a colossal anvil-shaped thundercloud over a plain with one enormous bolt of real lightning driving straight down from it like a hammer onto a dark fortress of dead trees.
vol_world_tree: @a vast ancient tree whose crown is lost in the stars and whose roots go down into a dark river, tiny figures of travellers standing at its foot looking up.
vol_svarog_forge: @an open-air forge on a mountain top at night, a huge anvil glowing from a bolt of real lightning that has just struck it, a hammer lying across it, sparks of molten iron running down.
vol_heart_of_winter: @a lump of clear blue ice the size of a human heart lying in the snow with a dark frozen shape inside it, hoarfrost spreading from it in a circle, an old rune-marked hand hovering over it.
vol_word_of_thunder: stands with his mouth wide open in a shout and the air in front of him visibly rippling outward, trees bending and creatures blown backwards.
vol_five_runes: @top-down view of five flat river stones laid in a ring on dark earth, each freshly painted with a different dark red rune, an old hand placing the fifth.
vol_prophecy: casts a handful of carved bone lots onto a spread wolf hide and bends low to read how they fell, firelight on the bones.
vol_sky_falls: @the night sky over a forest torn by dozens of falling burning stones streaking down at once, trees already on fire, tiny pale creatures running in every direction.
vol_ancient_oak: @a thousand-year-old oak with a trunk wider than a hut and a hollow like a doorway, hung with hundreds of faded ribbons and charms, an old man resting his forehead against the bark.
vol_rain_of_fire: raises both arms as burning embers and flaming brands rain down out of a red sky onto a crowd of pale creatures.
vol_double_voice: chants with his head thrown back while his own long shadow on the rock wall behind him chants too, with its mouth open wider than his.
vol_blessing: lays both hands on the bowed heads of two kneeling companions, a hunter in a wolf pelt and a gaunt woman, under the branches of an old oak.
vol_circle_of_stones: @a ring of nine tall weathered standing stones on a moonlit hill, each carved with one rune, a small fire in the centre and a lone old man sitting beside it.
vol_calling: stands at the edge of a cliff blowing a long birch-bark horn toward a dark forest, and from between the trees a bear, an elk and a flock of ravens are coming to him.
